StatementLog.title: StatementLog
StatementLog.description: A recorded spoken statement with real-time SmartSpectra physiological metrics and deception verdict.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this statement log.

transcript.description: Speech-to-text transcription of what was said.

isLie.description: True when physiological indicators flag the statement as deceptive.

deceptionScore.description: Calculated physiological stress/deception probability score from 0 to 100.

pulseRate.description: Measured pulse rate in BPM at the time of the statement.

breathingRate.description: Measured breathing rate in BPM at the time of the statement.

hrvRmssd.description: Measured heart rate variability RMSSD in milliseconds.

expression.description: Detected facial expression and confidence at the time of the statement.

reason.description: Summary of physiological indicators that triggered the verdict.

notes.description: Optional reviewer notes attached to the statement log.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the statement was logged (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the statement log was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/statement_logs/{logId}.description: Per-user history of spoken statements analyzed for physiological deception indicators.
